profile.headline: Team Coach @ Guardian Life | Certified SAFe® Practitioner | Certified SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager |
profile.summary:
As a Senior Scrum Master/Team Coach at Guardian Life, I contribute to the development and maintenance of software solutions that help millions of people protect their future and secure their lives. I use my professional skills to create and optimize databases, queries, and reports that support the business needs and goals. I also collaborate with other engineers, product owners, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality software products and services that meet the customer expectations and satisfaction. I have multiple certifications from Scaled Agile, Inc., including Certified SAFe® 5 Practitioner and Certified SAFe® 5 Product Owner/Product Manager.

I am passionate about creating value and impact for both my employers and my clients, and I strive to learn and grow as a professional and a leader.
